name: Every prompt is registered and overridable
prose: definePrompt registers every prompt the engine sends, in seven groups. Overrides land as plain .txt files the engine re-reads, so a change applies on the next turn with no restart. orphanedPromptFiles reports overrides whose prompt no longer exists.
invariant: All 43 registered prompts appear in the catalog, an override file is re-read live, and emptying a prompt cancels its inference round rather than sending a blank message.
